# Official V2 artifact facts: final quality runtime-evidence addendum

Verdict: **PASS within the task owner's scoped code-quality and execution-evidence gates**. No new actionable finding. Source commit `830ff53de76dbecd5fc3761f1c5f5bae164763c2`, based on protected `ac58815bb268d338bea40a31fff630734cd719f4`. Root's combined app/native/full-workspace CI, exact parity captures and protected merge remain pending and are not waived by this verdict.

## Actual Rust gates reviewed

The retained normal `cargo test --locked -p android_tools --all-features --message-format=json` receipt exits0. Its raw log has six unfiltered successful suite summaries: **85+28+20+21+29+19 = 202 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored, 0 filtered**. Both complete original ordering ports appear individually as passing tests. The 28 new tests include the current strict positional-envelope/DTO/tagged-enum regression, preserved prior assertions and the final `["absent",null]` slot case. The logged results demonstrate that the previously reviewed remote-Self forwarding compiled and its valid/invalid boundaries executed; no inferred template execution is substituted for the actual run.

Compiler JSON names the current worktree source paths, normal Cargo library and all six test artifacts with **fresh:false**. The crate-root freshness receipt records equal source bytes before and after the mtime touch. The runtime Rust probe was linked against that same normal Cargo rlib, with matching recorded dependency identity. I rehashed the currently retained rlib (`bf2d8ee866f659ee864387a311a0749c168b3c2e6fb06c06226ca8f0713e00ff`), 28-test ELF (`e5aec644871ca23c82482c60e6f47314719d96376b8ef14406b85ab7ba223b0e`), Rust probe source (`5551985487b7e87f31963365ccf203f138de5f7bb4ebb2d5f4ca9d9b9a971dca`) and probe ELF (`531cc5f5ee7ca35a304513a9f8ab0b8f7246232e8674a10fa5239f4dfd19702f`); all match their recorded identities.

The repository strict `./script/clippy --locked -p android_tools` receipt exits0; its raw log explicitly expands to release/all-targets/all-features/deny-warnings. `cargo fmt --all -- --check` exits0 with an empty raw output log. The normal locked all-feature library build exits0 and reuses the exact library freshly compiled during the preceding test run; this later reuse is recorded as fresh:true and is not misrepresented as a second recompilation. These are actual owner's gates reviewed here; I did not re-run them.

The initially failed execution wrapper (`/usr/bin/time` missing) is retained with `cargoStarted:false` and has not been counted as a completed test run. Earlier source preparation failures, frozen snapshots and review FAIL/PASS records remain retained. No existing test, fixture or assertion was removed, ignored or weakened to obtain these passes.

## Bridge and SDK evidence reviewed

The frozen runtime Gradle bridge is byte-exact to production SHA `508ecc9987932f8d184983f551eca0cb1bc9efa6ed12806dcaff8a0a2f6880b7`. The helper-boundary probe contains the extracted current production required/captured/collection/map/artifact closure bytes; its preparation identity remains separate from the actual exit0 execution receipt. The Groovy boundary command serializes **11 cases**, then the retained current-library Rust probe asserts the unavailable null/wrong shapes, available-empty values, ordered duplicate paths, Android/Java differences, nullable Android tasks and absent artifact. Those Rust assertions exit0. This supplies executed bridge-helper boundary coverage; it is not fabricated official SDK behavior or a substitute for real-model captures.

Five separate current-source official SDK commands and matching Rust assertion processes exit0: Java source BuildConfig, bytecode JAR BuildConfig, custom DSL field forcing Java despite a bytecode request, disabled BuildConfig, and disabled-artifact mode. Each raw Gradle log contains exactly one model record and BUILD SUCCESSFUL; each Rust stderr is empty. I compared every serialized generated-artifact module with its decoded Rust output: all five are equal. The inspected probe checks consumer/revision binding, official variant and BuildConfig task identities, generated JAR classification/content distinct from source folders, modeled resources/assets outside the build folder, absent fixtures, invalid variant lookup and release host/device map emptiness. **The disabled-artifact run confirms baseline-empty release maps; it does not prove a before/after removal of previously enabled release artifacts.**

Ten current toolchain file hashes match the SDK identity record, including three official AGP9.4 jars, Gradle launcher, JDK release/java and Android platform/build-tools descriptors. Observed versions are AGP9.4.0, producer23.0, minimum consumer66.1, Gradle9.6.1, JDK21.0.12.1+1, Android platform37/build-tools37.0.0. This is explicitly supplementary compatibility evidence rather than pinned Studio helper equivalence. The five original generated-project-view flows remain unported, with zero original runtime-flow credit from these probes.

## Preservation, packaging and cleanup

I rehashed all eight final frozen source/data identities, all **184 protected originals**, and the complete **4,612-file** fixed-exclusion whole-source guard: all match. The guard still covers code, fixtures, assets and nested files; packaging direct report/ports JSON and evidence JSON/log files introduces no widened source exclusion. All 13 original/private copied fixture inputs are currently restored and match their source hashes at both roots. The canonical parity ledger remains unchanged.

The final cleanup receipt preserves content checks while explicitly explaining a later Git index-byte difference as stat/cache refresh. It does not claim the index bytes remained identical after that refresh. All five owned daemon logs rehash correctly and contain exit evidence; their exact PIDs are currently absent. Unowned processes were left untouched. The stored preparation records with executed:false remain historical preparation records, paired with separate actual execution receipts rather than overwritten.

The owner released the shared Cargo lease. The generated 85-unit-test ELF has since been retired by Root for app-build capacity; I inspected `/workspace/android-studio-artifacts/tree-adapter-integration/superseded-v2-unit85-elf-retirement.json`. It retains exact bytes303989152/SHA `205534950afe41974d7f65395b2529cceb204b6c3cce211324d6ea7116ff613d`, owner authorization, accessible-process checks and their disclosed limitations. The unit test source and raw 202-test/compiler receipts remain. The 28-test ELF and Rust probe remain present and were rehashed in this review. Generated cache retirement is not removal or weakening of a test.

All **67 direct portable JSON/log files with same-name external counterparts** were compared byte-for-byte and match, preserving raw logs rather than normalizing their whitespace. Reviewer Markdown reports are packaged separately as JSON text evidence, so they are not included in that direct counterpart count. The current task report states only owner gates passed. The two proposed parity rows remain status unported with lead_exact_capture_pending; owner passing evidence has not been prematurely promoted into canonical completion. No entire-suite or runtime-case census is inferred from the selected ordering methods.

## Measurement and scope limits

`runtime-measurement-method.json` candidly states that the exact executed orchestration runner source was not retained. It records the per-PID posix_spawn/wait4/Linux ru_maxrss method and commands, not a claim that reconstructed source was executed. Reported timing/RSS describes the **entire probe process**, including startup, input, both model decoders, assertions and serialization; the raw field name decoderProcessPeakRssKiB does not establish decoder-only memory. Cargo/Clippy peaks include build-tool child processes; Gradle launcher peaks exclude the separate daemon. No IDE startup, hardware, large-project budget or reproducible benchmark conclusion is drawn from those numbers.

The existing official Gradle/AGP JVM SDK getter bridge remains the documented non-Rust exception. Rust owns decoding, version policy and validation. This task adds no tree renderer/controller, Kotlin-facet inference or language server. Studio generated-root filtering and the full original five generated-tree flows remain pending. Root must still execute matching-source application/native behavior, full workspace CI and exact source-bound parity capture before protected merge. This scoped quality PASS does not say the IDE, Phase1 or full task workflow is complete.

No runtime, compiler, Clippy, formatter, Gradle, app launch, cache mutation, source edit, Git mutation or subagent dispatch was performed by this reviewer. Only static source/artifact/log/hash inspection and this external report were produced.
